# pcd_networking_port (Resource)

Manages a Neutron port in PCD. A port is a virtual switch connection on a network; it can be attached to an instance, carry floating IPs, or host allowed-address-pairs for HA/VRRP setups.

`fixed_ip` and `allowed_address_pairs` capture your requested configuration and are not refreshed from the server on read (Neutron fills in addresses and MACs that would otherwise churn the plan); use the computed `all_fixed_ips` to reference the addresses Neutron actually assigned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_networking_network" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-network"
}

resource "pcd_networking_subnet" "example" {
  network_id = pcd_networking_network.example.id
  name       = "tf-example-subnet"
  cidr       = "10.0.0.0/24"
  ip_version = 4
}

resource "pcd_networking_port" "example" {
  network_id     = pcd_networking_network.example.id
  name           = "tf-example-port"
  description    = "Managed by Terraform"
  admin_state_up = true

  fixed_ip = [
    {
      subnet_id  = pcd_networking_subnet.example.id
      ip_address = "10.0.0.10"
    }
  ]

  allowed_address_pairs = [
    {
      ip_address = "10.0.0.20"
    }
  ]

  tags = ["env:example"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) The network this port belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `admin_state_up` (Boolean) The administrative state of the port (true = up).
- `allowed_address_pairs` (Attributes Set) Additional IP/MAC pairs the port is allowed to source traffic from (VRRP/HA). Not refreshed from the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allowed_address_pairs))
- `description` (String) A description of the port.
- `device_id` (String) The ID of the device (e.g. instance) using the port.
- `device_owner` (String) The entity type using the port (e.g. compute:nova).
- `fixed_ip` (Attributes List) Requested fixed IPs. Each entry pins the port to a subnet and optionally a specific address. Not refreshed from the server; see `all_fixed_ips`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fixed_ip))
- `mac_address` (String) The MAC address of the port. Setting a specific MAC forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) The name of the port.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `security_group_ids` (Set of String) Security groups applied to the port. Omit to inherit the network's default group; set to `[]` to apply none.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags applied to the port.
- `tenant_id` (String) The owning project. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `all_fixed_ips` (List of String) The IP addresses Neutron assigned to the port, in order.
- `id` (String) The port ID.
- `status` (String) The operational status of the port.

<a id="nestedatt--allowed_address_pairs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allowed_address_pairs`

Required:

- `ip_address` (String) Allowed IP address or CIDR.

Optional:

- `mac_address` (String) Allowed MAC address. Defaults to the port MAC.


<a id="nestedatt--fixed_ip"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fixed_ip`

Optional:

- `ip_address` (String) A specific IP address to assign.
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet to allocate the fixed IP from.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_networking_port.example <id>
```
